seo.aeoSummary: Password-protect text processes files and text entirely inside your browser tab using /wasm/crypto/file-encrypt-v1.wasm (Tier D). Zero bytes are uploaded to any server.

faqs.question: Does Password-protect text upload my files or text to a server?
